query.en: Design a business card (standard 3.5×2in ratio, shown front-only): a single bold monogram/initial mark top-left, a thin full-width rule beneath it, and a right-aligned contact block (name, title, email, phone) in one accent color on a neutral off-white ground. No logo image, no gradient, no drop shadow — the monogram is drawn typographically, not a placeholder image.
